necessity_paragraph: The denial code CO-97 incorrectly bundles CPT 93271, which is medically necessary to evaluate recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness suggestive of supraventricular tachycardia and sick sinus syndrome. This prolonged cardiac rhythm monitoring is indicated for diagnosis codes I49.5 and I47.1 to assess arrhythmic causes given the patient's history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction (Z86.73).
